why: This case exists to lock the MATCHING, and it is the only one of the three that the old matching FAILED. The `fail/` has a catalog sentence crossed by a ``: `Mesa de jantar em madeira macica`. Cutting at the first `<` — which is what the pattern `/> *([^<>{}\n][^<>{}]{18,}?) *` crossing it, and with no literal: both pieces of text come from `conteudo/inicio.json`. The difference between the sides is only where the text comes from — which is exactly the assertion of §12.3.
